arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Lineup feature icon, palette correction study.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING OPAQUE MASTER and is the edit target, not inspiration for a redraw.
Change ONLY the colored background hue/value. Keep the exact existing pale off-white foreground pixels, symbol silhouette, edges, stroke weights, holes, placement, spacing, apparent size and scale unchanged. Do not redraw, reinterpret, rotate, shrink, enlarge or add any foreground shape. Retain the simple flat planar app-icon style and a very gentle directional top-left to bottom-right gradient.
Make the palette noticeably HAPPY, clean and luminous, a large visible departure from earthy restrained colors. Bright means clean hue and high value, not a dark color with increased saturation.
Keep the square fully opaque, at least 1024 x 1024 pixels. The colored background must fill all four edges and corners, with zero exterior padding. Do not add a corner mask; the existing native preparation tool owns it.
No relief, bevel, cast shadow, texture, shine, bubble/radial gradient, glow, decoration, extra colors, text or rainbow foreground.

Color-only change for scroll:
Replace the current sage/olive background with fresh SPRING / MINT GREEN around #43C77A. Use a gentle clean gradient from about #53D58A at top-left to #31B96D at bottom-right. It must read lively mint/spring green, never sage, khaki, olive, muddy moss, teal or dark forest green. Preserve both existing off-white vertical arrows EXACTLY.
